# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. The engine jumps from milestone 132 through 148, bringing variable font support end-to-end (SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp), color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release for anyone relying on legacy typeface-resolution nulls or a Vulkan 1.0 device — read the breaking changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default** — Upstream removed the lazy "resolve default at draw time" behavior, so an unset SKFont.Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of resolving to the platform default — MeasureText now returns 0. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and check Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null** — SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font so text keeps working, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms now consistently fall back to SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family name, so FromFamilyName is never null. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null** — Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ (previously able to return null) now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The native offset is a 32-bit int, so out-of-range offsets used to silently truncate. They now throw OverflowException, and the overload is obsolete (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; on a 1.0 instance/device it calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process rather than returning null, and managed code cannot catch it. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave it at its default 0). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer use Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend.
- **Vulkan GRVkBackendContextNative loses five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice — Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo and loses value-equality** — The Vulkan Ycbcr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp GR casing convention and gains a new Components field. The old name, its IEquatable<T> implementation, and its ==/!= operators are gone — update references and rebuild. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m148** — The bundled engine advances through m132, m133, m147 and lands on m148, folding in the upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes merged along the way — the biggest engine jump in a single SkiaSharp release. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Variable font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp end to end, and SKFont/SKTypeface gain color font palette selection and hardened variable-font handling. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Managed default typeface resolution** — Default typeface lookup moves to the managed layer (fixing #3693) so consumers can observe or override the fallback without a native round-trip, and the legacy font manager entry point sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface is restored for downstream code that depends on it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))

## API Surface

- **SKSamplingOptions on surface-to-surface draws** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions, so callers can pick the mipmap and filter mode instead of an implicit default. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Zero-copy stream conversion and animated WebP encoding** — SKStream.GetData() turns any seekable stream into an SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy, and SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP files from a frame sequence. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772), [#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz wrappers** — HarfBuzzSharp gets a proper HBColor struct matching hb_color_t, plus previously missing or mis-named API wrappers filled in as part of a naming-convention pass. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKGLView rendering after MAUI tab switches** — Fixes SKGLView failing to render again after switching away from and back to a MAUI TabBar tab on Android. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **SKPath finalizer and pixel-span offset fixes** — Fixes a finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath, corrects SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) to use Height instead of Width for its offset, and further fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **WinUI Projection DLL restored for .NET 9** — Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers referencing SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down (fixing #3817), and moves the native-compatibility gate from a [ModuleInitializer] into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable initialization order. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))
- **Legacy text/font APIs promoted to compile errors** — The SKPaint text/font members obsoleted in v3, and the remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs, are now compile errors instead of warnings — move typeface and text size onto SKFont if you haven't already. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets** — Adds Linux Bionic as a supported native asset target and adds Tizen x64/arm64 native build support. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple TFM realignment** — Fixes Apple platform target framework monikers: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for applications. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates libexpat to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, expat to 2.8.1, and harfbuzz to 14.2.0. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds variable-font shaping and an HBColor value type, drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
